title: Rav Ashi bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 66b: “Rav Nachman bar Barukh said that Rav Ashi bar Avin said that Rav Yehudah said.” Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Idi bar Avin, as do the Rif and the Rosh. See also Moed Katan 16a.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied בא ברוך is read as bar Barukh on the support of the William Davidson digital Shabbat 66b, which fully writes Rav Nachman bar Barukh, Rav Ashi bar Avin and Rav Yehudah. The supplied הרי״ך is interpreted as the Rif; that commentary text has not been independently inspected here.
